title: The small team advantage
subtitle: A concise collection of practical notes, experiments, and ideas for people building what comes next.

notes.title: hahahahahah art of direction
notes.paragraph: Small teams move with purpose when everyone can see the horizon and understand the next step.

notes.title: Keep the signal clear
notes.paragraph: Simple roles and open communication help a crew respond together when the water changes.

notes.title: Make room for every strength
notes.paragraph: A resilient team brings different skills together, trusting each person to contribute where they are strongest.

notes.title: Steady progress beats noise
notes.paragraph: Choose a pace the team can sustain. Consistent progress carries a project farther than constant urgency.

notes.title: Learn from the crossing
notes.paragraph: After each challenge, share what worked and what did not. The next voyage gets better when the whole crew learns.
